The '''Trans-Nebular sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was named for a large [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] found within the sector.

==Astrography==
Located at the outer edge of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], the sector was surrounded by the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian]], [[Herdessa sector/Legends|Herdessa]] and [[Daimar sector/Legends|Daimar sectors]] on the Middle Rim side and the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl]], [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis]] and [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sectors]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] side.<ref name="EAOC" />

The sector is named for the [[Trans-Nebular Zone]], which was the primary "landmark". It contained over a dozen systems, including the [[Goroth system/Legends|Goroth system]] and the [[Vestor Nebula/Legends|Vestor Nebula]], for which the Zone was named. At the center of the [[Nebula/Legends|Nebula]] was the [[Vestor Pulsar]], a relatively stable [[Neutron star/Legends|Neutron star]]. The pulsar served as navigation beacon, but the nebula itself was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] "dead zone".<ref name="GSE" />

The sector contained approximately eighty stars and was located around 10 [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] within the boundaries of the Mid Rim. Planets in the sector included [[Milarian]], the [[Baylin Cluster/Legends|Baylin Cluster]] and [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. [[Hyperspace route/Legends|Hyperspace routes]] towards the systems inside the nebula were dangerous and difficult and often required two or three jumps.<ref name="GSE" />

==History==
The dangerous nature of the Trans-Nebular Zone made any [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] of the area a difficult operation. Over the time, several dozen scouting and survey [[Starship/Legends|ships]] had been lost due to interferences of the pulsar. Planets and civilizations inside the Zone were discovered [[8000 BBY|relatively late]] in galactic history.<ref name="GSE" />

Around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the sector was colonized by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] as well as exiled [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] pilgrims known as [[Barralenal]]. Both groups were very expansionistic and soon came into conflict. The sector was ruled at that time by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Matri Bey]]. While a capable bureaucrat, she was unable to stop both factions from going to [[Corellian/Aqualish war|war]]. The conflict forced several unaligned planets to take sides, except for Goroth, which managed to remain neutral.<ref name="GSE" />

During [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the sector was governed first by a [[Moff (Trans-Nebular sector)|Moff]] who betrayed the Empire, and after his execution, by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nebin Cray]]. Cray was later replaced by Moff [[Gal Brello]].<ref name="GSE" /> Between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Rebel activity was reported in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Trans-Nebular sector was probably among the first to overthrow Imperial rule.<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
